summary: Retrieve albums belonging to one or more users
description: Returns the albums that a user (or a set of users) has added to their 'myalbums' collection. The 'relation' parameter currently only supports 'myalbums'. The response includes album details and can be ordered by the date the relation was updated. Note that 'client_id' is mandatory and at least one of 'id', 'access_token' or 'name' must be provided. The 'limit' parameter caps at 200 rows even when set to 'all'.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Wraps the JSON response in a JavaScript callback (JSONP). Only works with format=json or jsonpretty and GET requests.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The position to start returning results from.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default 10, max 200. The keyword 'all' is accepted but still limited to 200 rows.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort results by the specified field(s). Append '_asc' or '_desc' to each field to control direction; ascending is default.

parameters.name: fullcount
parameters.description: If true, response headers include 'results_fullcount' with the total number of rows that would be returned without limit/offset.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: One or more user IDs (does not require an access token).

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: OAuth2 access token of the Jamendo user whose data is being requested.

parameters.name: album_id
parameters.description: One or more album IDs to filter results.

parameters.name: relation
parameters.description: Relation type; currently only 'myalbums' is supported.

responseFields.name: headers
responseFields.description: Metadata about the request, including status, code, and result counts.

responseFields.name: results
responseFields.description: Array of user objects each containing user info and an 'albums' array with album details.

notes: At least one of 'id', 'access_token' or 'name' must be supplied together with 'client_id'.
Even when 'limit=all' is used, the maximum number of rows returned is capped at 200.
The 'order' parameter accepts a suffix '_asc' or '_desc' to indicate sorting direction; ascending is default.
The 'callback' parameter only works when 'format' is set to json or jsonpretty and the request method is GET.
